events.description:
Celebrate Hawai‘i and Pacific filmmaking with ‘Ohina Labs and Capitol Modern at an evening gathering honoring the 2026 ‘Ohina Labs filmmaker cohort and the local creative community. Connect with artists, storytellers, filmmakers, and supporters while celebrating the next generation of independent filmmaking.

The evening will feature the announcement of the 2026 ‘Ohina Greenlight Award winner, recognizing one filmmaker and their project with additional mentorship, funding, and production support to bring their screenplay to life as a completed film.

Guests can also enjoy a rotating presentation of short films created by previous ‘Ohina Labs cohorts in Capitol Modern’s intimate onsite theatre.

events.description: Join us for our self-guided writing circle that will be on every other Monday from 12-1:30 PM. This is a small circle that is a safe place to practice your writing skills, learn from others, and share your own work, thoughts, and dreams.

events.title: Hawaiian Steel Guitar – Demonstrations and Lessons
events.description: Back by popular demand is Daniel Tremblay of HIMELE! Listen and learn from Daniel, as he teaches the history of Hawaiian Steel Guitars, and how to play. Lessons will take place in the Graphic novel nook, and instruments will be provided!
